name: 75672 · Marshall, TX
findings: ZIP 75672 (Marshall) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75672 (Marshall) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 75672 (Marshall) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 9 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
